name: elim-kirche-serviceportal
description: Cloudflare-Workers-Anwendung für das Elim Kirche Serviceportal

scripts.build: npm run build:prototype && npm run build:assets
scripts.check: npm run build && tsc --noEmit && wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.check:test: npm run build && tsc --noEmit && wrangler deploy --env test --dry-run
scripts.deploy:test: npm run check:test && npm run db:migrate:test && wrangler deploy --env test
scripts.check:preview: npm run build:preview && tsc --noEmit && wrangler deploy --env preview --dry-run
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run check:preview && node scripts/check-deploy-source.cjs && npm run db:migrate:preview && npm run db:initialize:preview && wrangler deploy --env preview
scripts.db:migrate:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env preview --remote
scripts.db:migrate:test: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env test --remote
